hydraulic-3-roll-plate-rollers.blurb_add: The NovoTech value-line HER hydraulic slip rolls take 12 ga to 1/2″ over 4 to 10 ft.

motorized-plate-rollers.blurb_add: NovoTech value-line ESR electric slip rolls cover sheet from 22 ga to 1/4″.

intro_add: The NovoTech value line adds ESR electric and HER hydraulic slip rolls, built in China, for sheet from 22 ga to 1/2″.

set.hero_brand_line: ISITAN and NovoTech premium line plate rolls are made in Turkey — ISITAN Makine since 1959, the NovoTech premium line built to NovoTech's specification — with European components; NovoTech's value-line slip rolls are built in China to NovoTech's specification. All sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech.
